name: cnet
runtimeDependencies: Amiga A600 or A1200 PCMCIA and card.resource, 68020 or later for the shipped build
Compatible CNet or NE2000-based PC Card and SANA-II network stack
notes: Aminet supplies the standard 8-bit cnet.device build tagged 68020+ (8.8.2007) and the accompanying English cnet.guide. The cnet16, 68000, debug and turbo I/O variants have different bytes.
MiamiDx.default references the installed unit 0 driver. cnet uses card.resource directly. Its guide discusses the separately catalogued CardPatch and CardReset.
DEVS:Networks is a shared system drawer.
